SD16-007.name: Loader-Arms
SD16-007.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any Nexus you control.

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

SD16-004.name: The BattleMaul Gordon
SD16-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Crush] (When Attacks)
Discard cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's level.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit would attack, unless the opponent sends a core from their Reserve to their Trash, it can't attack.

SD16-001.name: The Giant Platoon
SD16-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, discard two cards from the opposing decktop.

SD16-X01.name: The GiantEmperor Alexander-XIII
SD16-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard five cards from the opposing decktop.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by exhausting a "Fighting Spirit" family Spirit you control, this Spirit refreshes.

SD16-002.name: The GreatFist Roger
SD16-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Charge]
Your non-Ultimate "opposing-deck-discarding effects" discard +1 card.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.

SD16-003.name: The HeavyJavelinGiant Lance
SD16-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Charge]
Your non-Ultimate "opposing-deck-discarding effects" discard +1 card.

[LV2]
All your Blue Nexuses can't be destroyed by opposing Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

SD16-005.name: The HydraTamer Bernhard
SD16-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy two opposing Cost 3 or less Spirits. For each Spirit destroyed by this effect, discard three cards from the opposing decktop.

SD16-008.name: The Ironwall Giant Fortress
SD16-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When you Nexuses are destroyed, by exhausting this Nexus, one of the destroyed Blue Nexuses remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2]
Give all your "Fighting Spirit" family Spirits: "[Crush] (When Attacks) Discard cards from the opposing decktop equal to this Spirit's LV."

SD16-006.name: The MagicSwordsman Clovis
SD16-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By destroying an opposing Nexus, discard seven cards from the opposing decktop.

[When Braved] [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
Opposing Cost 4 or less Spirits can't attack.
